newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates up on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates up on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates traded at higher levels on Sunday amid a persistent shortage of funds and dealers said rates were likely to open at similar levels on Monday.
Onvernight funds were traded in the range of 23 percent and 24 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said. Banks refrained from borrowing for longer periods because of the high rates.
Dealers said the rates will remain pegged at higher levels because no major inflow was expected on Monday.
